messages:
maria: quick PM follow-up  ETL lag on 2026-03-12 caused missing spans and incorrect aggregates. need owners, short ETAs, and how we'll verify remediation.

ajay: i'll own detection + dashboarding. will add per-deploy span reconciliation + missing_span counter. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

dave: i'll own pipeline fix and backfill. culprit looks like windowing regression from reorder PR. plan: revert in staging, add ordering integration test, run targeted backfill for 03/12-03/14. ETA: Wed COB.

sasha: i'll own alerts + CI gating. adding prom alert median_etl_processing_ms >120s(5m) and a synthetic post-deploy span-count check, gating integration test in CI. ETA: Tue AM.

observability-bot: Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/pms/ETL-2026-03-12  span-drop-rate x3.

maria: please post PR links and a one-paragraph runbook for oncall triage. note recurring pattern: similar ordering-touching regressions ~6-8 weeks apart.

ajay: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/mon/pulls/523  added SQL to surface suspect batches.

dave: backfill PR/job: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/434, job bf-20260315-27. revert commit: 3a9f2b.

sasha: CI PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/121  adds synthetic and postdeploy reconciliation. runbook snippet added: "if span-drop spike -> pause deploys, run backfill job, notify #incidents & oncall."

maria: recap owners: ajay (detection) EOD tomorrow; dave (pipeline+backfill) Wed COB; sasha (alerts+CI) Tue AM. i'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm and will post final signoff when done. :white_check_mark:
